title: Data source candidate
description: One candidate free data source proposed by the research-analyst subagent, written to research/candidates/<slug>.json. Approval and implementation happen outside this file (a human decision, then a normal add-data-source task) - this schema only fixes the shape of the proposal.

name.description: Human-readable source name, e.g. 'FRED 30-Year Fixed Mortgage Rate'

slug.description: Matches the candidate JSON's filename stem

gap.description: The research/gaps.json factor key this addresses, if any (e.g. 'interest_rate')

license.description: License/ToS summary; must confirm no login wall and no commercial-use restriction

cost.description: Must be free; note any rate limit

history_available.description: How far back data goes, if known

correlation.description: Output of app/research/evaluate_series.py against FHFA HPI growth / ZORI, once that exists. Omit if not computed.
